report: High-pitched cry, microcephaly, left-leg hypotonia, VSD, exotropia and developmental delay, with karyotype 46,XX,del(p15.2) and MRI changes (brainstem hypoplasia, white-matter atrophy, thin corpus callosum, reduced myelination), indicate a chromosomal multisystem disorder, excluding infection or perinatal injury. Experts map the deletion to the 5p15.3–p15.2 Cri-du-chat critical region, indicating de novo Cri-du-chat syndrome; FISH/MLPA and CMA/WES confirmation remain pending.
